msg: Note the number of mushrooms you get for your first choice - if it is over 5 keep selecting this colour gnome.  I found that when the gnome with the tall purple hat had the most mushrooms, the gnome with the small blue hat also had the most mushrooms.  The tall brown hat gnome and the small pink hat gnome are also higher yielding at the same time.  The highest mushroom score is 9 - when you get to a yield of 3 or 4 mushrooms I suggest changing your choice to the other gnome.  Good luck!
